title: Morning, two sets of prints
logline: One of the mornings: the prints only. A man's boots and the two-one of the pup, going out across the flats toward the tide line, no one at the end of them yet. The page is the trail.

panels.composition: Wet mudflats at low tide with two trails of prints — a man's boots and a three-legged dog's two-one pattern — going out from the foreground toward a distant tide line with no one visible at the end.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, wet tidal mudflats with two trails of prints, boot prints and a three-legged dog's pattern, running from the foreground toward a distant tide line with no one visible at the end, luminous, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
